n1.prompt: Over 5 seconds, grandma maintains her camera-facing gaze as her neutral expression gradually becomes a gentle, warm smile. Remaining seated in her original posture, she naturally lifts one resting hand, gives a small friendly wave with relaxed wrist movements, then lowers it back to its original resting position, still smiling. Keep her likeness, hair, glasses, clothing, age and proportions unchanged. Preserve all surroundings, daylight, shadows and original photograph colors. Camera locked throughout: retain the original composition, framing and source aspect ratio, with no zoom, pan or crop. No added text, captions or logos.
